title: Story premise EDU008: The Giant Three-Point Jump
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (basic math). Hook: Did the score triple, or did the camera move? Takeaway/theme: Chart scale can change visual emphasis without changing the numbers.
description: An announcer wants an honest chart of scores 97 and 100, but a cropped vertical axis makes the change look enormous. Restoring a labeled zero baseline and displaying the difference lets the audience compare both views.
